newsitem.title: USA: Haemonetics sees no change in trends soon.
newsitem.headline: Haemonetics sees no change in trends soon.

text.p: Haemonetics Corp, which saw its third quarter gross profits hurt by a variety of factors, said Tuesday it does not see any change in those trends in the near term.
Haemonetics said its third quarter profits were hurt by a a change in the company's sales mix, the startup of its blood bank services business and other factors.
Haemonetics said the other factors leading to the drop were its inability to get higher prices from its customers worldwide for higher-cost products and the strengthening of the dollar.
"We do not see any change in these trends for the near term and hope to minimize any future reduction in gross profit," Chairman, President and Chief Executive John White said in a statement.
Gross profits for the quarter ended December 28 were 49.7 percent versus 53.6 percent, the company said.
